fixed_ambient_law.objective: Unweighted sum over all 11 Table 1 rows of [V300*exp(alpha*(T-300))-Vobserved]^2, in A^6; V300 and constant alpha free.

objective: Minimize sum_i [(P_BM3(Vtrue_i,T_i;theta)-Pobs_i)/sigmaP_i]^2 + [(Vtrue_i-Vobs_i)/sigmaV_i]^2. Six global quadratic-modulus coefficients and 37 latent volumes free. Exact errors-in-variables objective, not a parameter-dependent effective-error denominator approximation.
temperature_law: K(T)=K300+a*(T-300)+b*(T-300)^2 and Kprime(T)=Kprime300+c*(T-300)+d*(T-300)^2. b,d multiply the full squared term (no one-half); second derivatives are 2*b and 2*d. Six coefficients jointly fitted to all 37 raw PVT rows with both coordinate errors.
numerical_parameterization: For u=(T-300)/573, each modulus is c0*(1-u)^2+2*c1*u*(1-u)+c2*u^2. K coefficients bounded 5-100 GPa and Kprime coefficients 3-20, guaranteeing positive reference moduli over 300-873 K. All solutions checked for active bounds. Ordinary polynomial coefficients/covariance are transformed exactly.
observational_assumptions: Printed P and V ESDs treated as independent Gaussian standard deviations within/between rows; no P-V or inter-row covariance supplied. Temperatures fixed because row-wise T errors are unreported. Au pressure-scale systematics are not included.
ambient_data_treatment: The 11 Table 1 ambient observations already determined the fixed expansion law. With V0(T) fixed, their predicted P=0 volumes do not depend on the four compression parameters; they add no information to this fit. No synthetic ambient pressure errors are assigned and the ambient law is not reoptimized.

quadratic_pv_errors.covariance_convention: Absolute supplied P/V errors; inverse profiled information, latent-volume block eliminated by Schur complement; not scaled by reduced chi-square.

linear_pv_errors.covariance_convention: Absolute reported P/V errors; inverse profiled J.T J, 37 latent volumes eliminated by Schur complement. No chi-square scaling.
linear_pv_errors.scaled_covariance_qualification: Alternative dispersion-scaled diagnostic only; inflation does not repair model inadequacy or unmodelled systematics.

quadratic_unweighted_pressure_baseline.covariance_convention: SSE/(N-ng)*inverse(J.T J); exact measured volumes and equal pressure weights.

independent_isotherm_pv_error_control.qualification: Four independent BM3 fits with the same fixed V0(T), same P/V errors and all rows. Diagnostic flexibility control, not a continuous EOS and not the earlier unweighted staged moduli.

qualifications: The quadratic model adds two global parameters: N-p=31 degrees of freedom versus 33 for the linear model. Compare both raw chi-square and reduced chi-square; this is an in-sample comparison, not external prediction validation.

Exact same fixed ambient expansion, source observations, P/V errors and independence assumptions as the linear fit. No outlier removal, pressure recalibration, robust clipping or ambient-law adjustment.

Primary covariance is local and absolute-sigma, after profiling all 37 latent volumes. Separate dispersion-scaled covariance is diagnostic only. Both omit fixed ambient-law uncertainty, unreported error correlations, temperature errors and model/phase discrepancy.

Quadratics are empirical interpolating forms over 300-873 K; only four distinct temperatures constrain their shape. Do not extrapolate or interpret coefficients as independently established thermodynamics.
The independent-isotherm control can retain scatter even without a temperature law; that diagnostic does not identify a physical cause or prove the source observations wrong.
